theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_dr_bounded_stronglyMeasurable_modification
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∃ ζ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n, StronglyMeasurable ζ ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ζ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ ζ =ᵐ[μ] ξ
